content: Morimori ma namlolo lolo Makromod Lalap leken kalarna

I wal'u na'ahoru! Makromod Lalap kukul Nin aki man wa'an de naledi ampun lalap maika me'e. Onne penia ya apanak rehirehi lewlewen mim lernohi Makromod Lalap Nin panaeku na'akeme la ilitolle Ai mamani. Lo'o mim hi'i heheni, onne naise mi mala mi kemmu namwali honoi kanani man mormori laa Makromod Lalap. Minima hini'i wenewhe onne moumou dewdewe la nahuwa'an Makromod Lalap akin, penia namwali ul'uli sasa'a ma namlolo.

Yom derne makani ri mormori rira honorok akin ma ka namlolo eni, maa mala mi honorok akin Makromod Lalap mamani, leke Ai nala honorok aki worworu herredi minim morimori ma ka namlolo eni. Lo'o mim hi'i heheni, mi mauroin Makromod Lalap Nin honorok panaeku lolo minim morimori, de mauroin mouropo inhawe man wa'an, inhawe ma nahuwa'an Makromod Lalap akin, noro inhawe ma namlolo Ai leken kalarna.

Makromod Lalap naledi Nina rere'e haharu maya'u me'e, de ya ala nounaku eniyeni ki mi na'akeme. Makromod Lalap naledi woroin ma na'ono maika dohodoho leke ik akin naili'il Ai. Maika eniyenihe heruwali akin naruri naili'il Ai, la heruwali ka naruri makun, maa onne na'akeme mai nano Makromod Lalap. Ende yon mehe ma'uli mi kemen ono minim woroin onne Makromod Lalap penia nala ki mi.
Ik kala wanakuku nano ik kemen eniyeni. Liman ein, oin makan, kilinna noro namehin rira honowok ka namnenehe, maa na'akeme rahinuhu rawinawar ri kemen leke namwali mahaku.
Namnenehe noro maika ma akin naili'il Kristus. Kade ik ri nammori, maa kamwali mahaku lolo Ai. Ik ida man paku ida naise ik kemen hana'arne na'akeme, ida man paku ida.

Ika dohdoho lernala woroin aimehi nano Makromod Lalap lernohi Nina rere'e haharu, de wa'an rehi ik kampe'el nair woroin onne kodi aki ma nahuwa'an. Ri ma nauroin loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan, loikaru wawa'an lernohi nin aki ma naili'il leke nin wanakunu mai nano Makromod Lalap.
Ri ma nampe'el ilitolle ri heri ri wali, ilitolle kokkoo. Ri ma nauroin wakuku, wakuku kokkoo.

Ri ma nauroin nala nounaku, nala nounaku ma na'alap ri akin, la ri man paku ri ma na'alehe haida-haida, yon sorno maa paku nodi aki man wa'an. Ri man leluwai makrana, leluwai makrana wawa'an, la ri ma naramyaka de paku ri heri ri wali, paku nodi aki ma nahuwa'an.
Ida ma naramyaka ida
Karamyaka ri heri ri wali kodi aki moumou. Sopoledi honorok aki man ailanne noro mormori man yak, la hi'i ha man wa'an mamani.
Mi ida ma naramyaka ida naise ma na'unara noro ma na'umo'oniwali, la ida man horhawe ida mamani.
Mampe'el howok la ilitolle Makromod Lalap Nina honowok modi aki man mou.

Lo'o mim lernala apinpinha, yon mi akim werek, maa wa'an rehi mi akim nahuwa'an, ono mi mauroin Makromod Lalap hi'i Nin nou namwali. Yom pelek mi akim nado'o, maa mamkene mamani, la yon hamlinu hi'i lir napanak mamani.

Lo'o minim ri heri ri wali ma akin naili'il Makromod Lalap enihe rira hahaa kan nokor lolo rir morimori akilere, malala minima hahaa tarana. Lo'o rin mai minim nakar, kokala wawa'anedi modi aki ma nahuwa'an.
Mapanak Makromod Lalap leke namre'e namharu ri man hi'i apinpinha mi, yono makneri maknai hi.
Lo'o ri aile man akin nahuwa'an, mi akim nahuwa'an wewerre, la lo'o ri aile man akin sus, mim sus wewerre haenhi.
Mori wawa'an noro ri heri ri wali, yono mim holi kukulu lalapa, maa holi helkaki namdaru noro ri ma na'alehe haida-haida, la yono ma'uli mi ma'aheni mauroin narehi.
Lo'o ri aile man hi'i ailanna ki mi, yono walhe noro ailanna, maa walha noro wawa'an. Hi'i wawa'an mamani leke rin po'on minima hini'i wenewhe wa'an wake'e.
Madiyaka mi wawa'an leke moro num ri heri ri wali na'akeme holi melina makai. Yon mi mamwali ma namhene holi melina makai!

I wal'u na'ahoru! Lere rin hi'i apinpinha me ailanna ki mi, yom walhe, ono na'amoli Makromod Lalap nala hunukum ma namlolo hi. Lolo Horok Lape raram Makromod Lalap na'aheni, “Ya'u penia man walhe, la Ya'u man hukum hi.”
Enimaa wa'an rehi mim lernohi Horok Lape Lirna ma na'aheni, “Lo'o num arwali namlara la marou, mala hanana'an nonomun hi, leke rawawa la hir herre rira hini'i wenewhe onne.”
Ende yom walha ri nin ailanna modi ailanna, maa walha ailanna modi ha man wa'an, leke nano minim hini'i wenewhe man wa'an onne mim rehiyedi ailanna onne me'e.
